title: colonel — remark

phrases.translation: [英]陆军中校；[美]陆军或空军、海军陆战队中校

sentences.sentence: What if they go on to behave as murderously as the colonel and his paid killers?
sentences.translation: 如果他们像他们的是上校和他的杀手们一样继续表现为杀气腾腾的又该怎么办？

sentences.sentence: Nothing remained of the colonel.
sentences.translation: 上校身后毫无遗物。

sentences.sentence: “We are now at the beginning of the beginning” of a new relationship, Pickering said.
sentences.translation: 皮克林说，我们现在处于两国新关系的“开端的开端”。

sentences.sentence: " Pickering agrees that the paper is "very important and original," adding that "it provides strong evidence that the neural coupling underlies the way that speakers come to understand each other.
sentences.translation: 皮克林同意这篇论文“非常重要并且十分新颖”，他还补充说，“这项研究为奠定了交谈双方能够彼此理解的神经耦合提供了强有力的证据。”

translations.translation: 重要的；决定性的；命中注定的

sentences.sentence: It was a fateful decision, one which was to break the Government.
sentences.translation: 那是一项重大的决定，一个将使政府垮台的决定。

sentences.sentence: Adam whistled happily on his way to work.
sentences.translation: 亚当在上班路上愉快地吹着口哨。

sentences.sentence: I heard this song on the radio and I’ve been whistling it all day.
sentences.translation: 我在收音机里听到这首歌，就吹了一整天这个调子的口哨。

sentences.sentence: He whistled a tune as he strolled down the corridor.
sentences.translation: 他口里吹着一首曲子沿着走廊缓步走去。

sentences.sentence: Larsson scored just minutes before the final whistle.
sentences.translation: 拉尔森就在终场哨声响起前几分钟进球得分。

sentences.sentence: She pulled the garment on and zipped it up.
sentences.translation: 她穿上衣服并拉好拉链。

sentences.sentence: a woollen scarf
sentences.translation: 羊毛围巾

sentences.sentence: I hesitate in this work.
sentences.translation: 我在这个作品中有所犹豫。

sentences.sentence: So if someone asks you out, never hesitate.
sentences.translation: 如果有人叫你出去玩，千万别犹豫！

sentences.sentence: Yet, this is where so many of us get stuck. We hesitate; we step back from obedience in order to speculate what we should do next -- even though Jesus has already told us what we must do.
sentences.translation: 然而，我们很多人往往在这里停滞不前，我们犹豫不决；即使主耶稣已经告诉我们当作的事，我们仍然往后退步，不顺服主，还说是为了看清楚下一步该怎么做。

translations.translation: 不舒服的；不安的；不自在的

sentences.sentence: This sofa is so uncomfortable.
sentences.translation: 这张沙发太不舒服了。

sentences.sentence: She always felt slightly uncomfortable in a hat.
sentences.translation: 她戴帽子总是觉得有点不自在。

sentences.sentence: I sat uncomfortably in my superseat for the rest of the journey feeling like a rotten heel.
sentences.translation: 在余下的旅程中，我浑身不自在地坐在我的“特等座”上，觉得自己差劲透了。

sentences.sentence: The wire meshscreen symbolizes the isolation And I know it still hovers out there in the periphery of my vision uncomfortably close despite the many successes I have amassed.
sentences.translation: 这个钢丝窗代表了隔离。 尽管我已经积聚了许多成功，但是我知道它仍然在我的视线边缘徘徊，非常近，令人不舒服。

translations.translation: 带来麻烦的；使人心烦的

sentences.sentence: a troublesome child
sentences.translation: 烦人的孩子

sentences.sentence: troublesome itching
sentences.translation: 难受的痒

sentences.sentence: He took a credit card out of his wallet.
sentences.translation: 他从钱包里拿出一张信用卡。

sentences.sentence: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
sentences.translation: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

sentences.sentence: Thieves broke into the offices and stole $150,000’s worth of computer equipment.
sentences.translation: 小偷破门进入办公室，偷走了价值15万美元的电脑设备。

sentences.sentence: They were nothing but petty thieves (= thieves who steal small things ) .
sentences.translation: 他们只不过是小毛贼。

sentences.sentence: She waved away his offer of the handkerchief.
sentences.translation: 她挥手拒绝了他递过来的手帕。

phrases.translation: 伪装，假扮成；托辞；以……为借口

sentences.sentence: He escaped across the border disguised as a priest.
sentences.translation: 他装扮成神父越境逃走了。

sentences.sentence: There’s no way you can disguise that southern accent.
sentences.translation: 你是无法掩盖那南方口音的。

sentences.sentence: His disguise didn’t fool anyone.
sentences.translation: 他的伪装没能骗过任何人。

sentences.sentence: A challenge is simply an opportunity in disguise.
sentences.translation: 一次挑战也就是一个被伪装的机会。

sentences.sentence: He is in disguise so none of his enemies will recognize him.
sentences.translation: 他做了些伪装因此他的敌人谁都没有认出他来。

sentences.sentence: You can turn unemployment into a blessing in disguise – if you have the right mindset.
sentences.translation: 如果你有一个良好的心态，你可以把失业转换成一种经过伪装的好事。

translations.translation: （见解或判断上）错误的；不正确的

sentences.sentence: I see I was mistaken about you.
sentences.translation: 我明白我错看了你。

translations.translation: 才华横溢的；光辉灿烂的；杰出的

sentences.sentence: I think that’s a brilliant idea .
sentences.translation: 我觉得那是个绝妙的主意。

sentences.sentence: She closed her eyes against the brilliant light .
sentences.translation: 强烈的光线下，她闭起了眼睛。

sentences.sentence: We sat outside in the brilliant sunshine .
sentences.translation: 我们坐在外面，沐浴在灿烂的阳光下。

sentences.sentence: She was dressed in brilliant white.
sentences.translation: 她穿着一身耀眼的白色。

sentences.sentence: The film was absolutely brilliant .
sentences.translation: 这部电影极为出色。

sentences.sentence: We’d classify Drabble’s novels under ‘Romance’.
sentences.translation: 我们把德拉布尔的小说归类为“言情小说”。

sentences.sentence: Families are classified according to the father’s occupation.
sentences.translation: 各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

sentences.sentence: Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
sentences.translation: 不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。

sentences.sentence: the chairman’s introductory remarks
sentences.translation: 主席的开场白

sentences.sentence: ‘This house must be very old,’ he remarked. “
sentences.translation: “这幢房子一定很古老了。”他说道。

text:
英语词汇 · 人教高中 · 第 136 单元

colonel
音标：英 /'kɜːn(ə)l/  美 /'kɝnl/
n. （陆军）上校
短语：lieutenant colonel — [英]陆军中校；[美]陆军或空军、海军陆战队中校
例句：What if they go on to behave as murderously as the colonel and his paid killers?
如果他们像他们的是上校和他的杀手们一样继续表现为杀气腾腾的又该怎么办？
例句：Nothing remained of the colonel.
上校身后毫无遗物。

Pickering
音标：英 /'pikəriŋ/  美 /'pikəriŋ/
皮克林（姓）
例句：“We are now at the beginning of the beginning” of a new relationship, Pickering said.
皮克林说，我们现在处于两国新关系的“开端的开端”。
例句：" Pickering agrees that the paper is "very important and original," adding that "it provides strong evidence that the neural coupling underlies the way that speakers come to understand each other.
皮克林同意这篇论文“非常重要并且十分新颖”，他还补充说，“这项研究为奠定了交谈双方能够彼此理解的神经耦合提供了强有力的证据。”

fateful
音标：英 /'feɪtfʊl; -f(ə)l/  美 /'fetfl/
adj. 重要的；决定性的；命中注定的
例句：It was a fateful decision, one which was to break the Government.
那是一项重大的决定，一个将使政府垮台的决定。

whistle
音标：英 /'wɪs(ə)l/  美 /'wɪsl/
v. 吹口哨；发出汽笛声
n. 口哨声；汽笛声
短语：blow the whistle — 告发；揭发
短语：clean as a whistle — 擦得净亮
例句：Adam whistled happily on his way to work.
亚当在上班路上愉快地吹着口哨。
例句：I heard this song on the radio and I’ve been whistling it all day.
我在收音机里听到这首歌，就吹了一整天这个调子的口哨。
例句：He whistled a tune as he strolled down the corridor.
他口里吹着一首曲子沿着走廊缓步走去。
例句：Larsson scored just minutes before the final whistle.
拉尔森就在终场哨声响起前几分钟进球得分。

garment
音标：英 /'gɑːm(ə)nt/  美 /'gɑrmənt/
n. （一件）衣服（外套、裙、袍等）；服装
短语：garment industry — 制衣业；成衣业
短语：garment factory — 服装厂，成衣工厂
短语：garment leather — 衣服革
短语：garment design — 衣服设计
短语：fur garment — 裘皮服装
短语：garment bag — 保护衣服用的塑胶套
短语：silk garment — 丝绸服装；绸衣
例句：She pulled the garment on and zipped it up.
她穿上衣服并拉好拉链。

woollen
音标：英 /'wʊlən/  美 /'wʊlən/
adj. 毛纺的；纯毛的（<美>woolen）
短语：woollen sweater — n. 绒衫
例句：a woollen scarf
羊毛围巾

hesitate
音标：英 /'hezɪteɪt/  美 /ˈhɛzətet/
v. 犹豫；踌躇
短语：don't hesitate — 别再犹豫了
短语：hesitate in — 吞吞吐吐
例句：I hesitate in this work.
我在这个作品中有所犹豫。
例句：So if someone asks you out, never hesitate.
如果有人叫你出去玩，千万别犹豫！
例句：Yet, this is where so many of us get stuck. We hesitate; we step back from obedience in order to speculate what we should do next -- even though Jesus has already told us what we must do.
然而，我们很多人往往在这里停滞不前，我们犹豫不决；即使主耶稣已经告诉我们当作的事，我们仍然往后退步，不顺服主，还说是为了看清楚下一步该怎么做。

uncomfortable
音标：英 /ʌn'kʌmf(ə)təb(ə)l/  美 /ʌn'kʌmftəbl/
adj. 不舒服的；不安的；不自在的
例句：This sofa is so uncomfortable.
这张沙发太不舒服了。
例句：She always felt slightly uncomfortable in a hat.
她戴帽子总是觉得有点不自在。

uncomfortably
音标：美 /ʌn'kʌmftəbli/
adv. 不舒服的；不自在地
例句：I sat uncomfortably in my superseat for the rest of the journey feeling like a rotten heel.
在余下的旅程中，我浑身不自在地坐在我的“特等座”上，觉得自己差劲透了。
例句：The wire meshscreen symbolizes the isolation And I know it still hovers out there in the periphery of my vision uncomfortably close despite the many successes I have amassed.
这个钢丝窗代表了隔离。 尽管我已经积聚了许多成功，但是我知道它仍然在我的视线边缘徘徊，非常近，令人不舒服。

troublesome
音标：英 /'trʌb(ə)ls(ə)m/  美 /'trʌblsəm/
adj. 带来麻烦的；使人心烦的
例句：a troublesome child
烦人的孩子
例句：troublesome itching
难受的痒

wallet
音标：英 /'wɒlɪt/  美 /'wɑlɪt/
n. 皮夹；钱包
例句：He took a credit card out of his wallet.
他从钱包里拿出一张信用卡。

outcome
n. 结果；效果
例句：People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

thief
音标：英 /θiːf/  美 /θif/
n. 小偷；贼
例句：Thieves broke into the offices and stole $150,000’s worth of computer equipment.
小偷破门进入办公室，偷走了价值15万美元的电脑设备。
例句：They were nothing but petty thieves (= thieves who steal small things ) .
他们只不过是小毛贼。

handkerchief
音标：英 /'hæŋkətʃɪf/  美 /'hæŋkɚtʃɪf/
n. 手帕；手绢；纸巾
例句：She waved away his offer of the handkerchief.
她挥手拒绝了他递过来的手帕。

disguise
音标：英 /dɪs'gaɪz/  美 /dɪs'ɡaɪz/
v. 伪装；假扮；遮掩
n. 伪装
短语：in disguise — 伪装；乔装
短语：a blessing in disguise — 塞翁失马
短语：in the disguise of — 伪装，假扮成；托辞；以……为借口
例句：He escaped across the border disguised as a priest.
他装扮成神父越境逃走了。
例句：There’s no way you can disguise that southern accent.
你是无法掩盖那南方口音的。
例句：His disguise didn’t fool anyone.
他的伪装没能骗过任何人。

in disguise
伪装（的）；假扮（的）
例句：A challenge is simply an opportunity in disguise.
一次挑战也就是一个被伪装的机会。
例句：He is in disguise so none of his enemies will recognize him.
他做了些伪装因此他的敌人谁都没有认出他来。
例句：You can turn unemployment into a blessing in disguise – if you have the right mindset.
如果你有一个良好的心态，你可以把失业转换成一种经过伪装的好事。

mistaken
音标：英 /mɪ'steɪk(ə)n/  美 /mɪ'stekən/
adj. （见解或判断上）错误的；不正确的
短语：be mistaken for — 被误认为…；被误解为
短语：mistaken identity — 认错人
例句：I see I was mistaken about you.
我明白我错看了你。

brilliant
音标：英 /ˈbrɪlɪənt/  美 /'brɪljənt/
adj. 才华横溢的；光辉灿烂的；杰出的
短语：brilliant blue — 鲜蓝；酞青；孔雀兰
短语：brilliant sunshine — 灿烂的阳光
短语：brilliant green — 亮绿
短语：coomassie brilliant blue — 考马斯亮蓝
短语：brilliant yellow — 亮黄
短语：brilliant white — 炽白光；亮白
短语：brilliant orange — 亮橙，亮桔红
例句：I think that’s a brilliant idea .
我觉得那是个绝妙的主意。
例句：She closed her eyes against the brilliant light .
强烈的光线下，她闭起了眼睛。
例句：We sat outside in the brilliant sunshine .
我们坐在外面，沐浴在灿烂的阳光下。
例句：She was dressed in brilliant white.
她穿着一身耀眼的白色。
例句：The film was absolutely brilliant .
这部电影极为出色。

classify
音标：英 /'klæsɪfaɪ/  美 /'klæsɪfaɪ/
v. 编排；分类；归类
短语：classify as — 把…分类为…
例句：We’d classify Drabble’s novels under ‘Romance’.
我们把德拉布尔的小说归类为“言情小说”。
例句：Families are classified according to the father’s occupation.
各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

remark
音标：英 /rɪ'mɑːk/  美 /rɪ'mɑrk/
n. 谈论；评述；言论
v. 谈论；评论；说起
短语：remark on — 评论；谈论；议论
例句：Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。
例句：the chairman’s introductory remarks
主席的开场白
例句：‘This house must be very old,’ he remarked. “
“这幢房子一定很古老了。”他说道。
